attributes.action: Bring P Diddy/Puff Daddy to the UK
attributes.additional_details:
An associate of mine who works at Two Snow Hill emailed me, saying "Bring my boy Didddddyyyyy!!! 😂😂😂 Bring him here man I miss my pookie".

Another goes "Ain't no party like a Diddy party! Thats for sure".

Some woman on social media posted a video of herself crying about her partner leaving after 12 years, so my associate commented "Don't cry girl, Didddddyyyyy's coming 😂😂😂 Get ready for a freakoff!"

This would be a beneficial thing for the UK, sign the petition and help fund this cause.
attributes.background: When Puff Daddy (Rapper) gets released from prison in Feb 2028, he should come to the UK and set up things like the White Party, regular Diddy parties and other business here. My Associates are missing him and want him here so bad.
